mission: Finish remaining production-mode deploy-gate tasks (P0/P1/P2) at production quality
summary: Deploy-gate task set is implemented in the working tree. P0: pooled Postgres, per-step transactions, Redis conn= no-op so simple mode does not crash, Postgres-native orphan recovery. P1: replay claims reconciled to re-run from latest snapshot, link_child persists child_work_ids, operator_actions wired from CLI/console. P2: atomic resource upsert, frozen one-level trigger DSL, JSON step logs plus Prometheus /metrics, stores bound once at construction. uv run ruff check . and pytest: 47 passed against local roost-pg-test.
decisions: Track A for replay: reword docs/labels, keep CLI verb dlq replay and /replay API.
Wire roost_operator_actions instead of dropping the table.
Freeze trigger DSL to one-level truthy keys rather than deleting it.
Resource locks use lease-style atomic upsert, not session advisory locks.
assumptions: Production DBs must apply migration 0002 before get_meta can SELECT children.
Operator action recording is production/Postgres only.
open_threads: Work is uncommitted. Production databases need roost migrate for 0002.
Lease-lost is checked before the durable write window, not during save.

commands: uv run ruff check . && ROOST_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=postgresql://roost:roost@localhost:55432/roost uv run pytest -q
validation.notes: 47 passed, ruff clean. Unique resource keys added to test_postgres_concurrency.py after leftover claims made acquire return False.
